data.name: Murderplanet
data.detailed_description:
Murderplanet is a high-octane action roguelike inspired by classic twin-stick shooters like Smash TV and Robotron 2084. Unlike traditional roguelikes, you design your build before the run begins.

Curate your own pool of Gears and Abilities before each run - surviving relentless waves of enemies long enough to bring your theoretical game-breaking synergies to fruition. Maximize your cash by slaying hordes of enemies, defending Capture Points, and gambling every dollar earned. Survive long enough to face the Boss, or double-down for even greater riches.

Freedom to Make Game Breaking Builds

  • Choose a loadout of up to 10 Gears that define your build’s possibilities

  • Gears are passive powers you level up through each run that range from raw stat boosts to wild mechanics that trigger chain reactions and screen-clearing effects

  • Prefer chaos? Take a look in the Bargain Bin for random Gear with enhanced effects and a chance for exclusive, overpowered items

Take Control of Your Playstyle

  • Pick 3 Abilities the player can use to drastically change how each run plays

  • These can be offensive, like shotgun blasts, giant AOE slams, or charged snipers; or defensive, like teleportation, toggled buffs, or shield walls

  • Pair these with support Abilities like summoning minions, channeled healing, or cooldown resets to truly break the game

Risks, Rewards, and Raised Stakes

  • Between each Combat Phase is a Shop Phase. Choose carefully to maximize your powers scaling

  • Gamble at the Slots, grab Bargain Bin deals, or crack Loot Chests for bulk power

  • Face Super Enemies, stage modifiers, and brutal bosses that force adaptation

data.short_description: Fight to the death in the arena-based action game show, Murderplanet. Make a loadout of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.
